summary_1line: Virata reconciles with the Pandavas, offers his daughter Uttara to Arjuna, who instead arranges her marriage to his son Abhimanyu amid a grand royal gathering.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Virata warmly embraces Yudhishthira and the Pandavas in his palace hall, overwhelmed with joy at their revealed identities.
Princess Uttara, adorned with jewels and gold, is led by royal women into the wedding hall where Abhimanyu awaits amid music and conch blasts.
Krishna arrives with a vast host of warriors, elephants, chariots, and horses filling the city of Matsya during the grand wedding celebration.
